third_party_evaluations.summary: Foundational Google Cloud literacy with shared-responsibility, IAM, and compliance basics.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 1, introductory: 2. The ordered median is introductory. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded scope is cloud literacy and shared-responsibility basics without experience requirements; vendor proctoring and a foundational hint do not establish an engineering practitioner baseline.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded shared responsibility, IAM and compliance basics provide a foundational cloud-security vocabulary. Zero experience and the limited entry hiring signal do not demonstrate cloud operations or leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cloud literacy, shared-responsibility and compliance basics require no experience. Proctoring does not turn this business-oriented foundation into an engineering credential.
